incident.root_cause_of_data_loss: polly held no push credential during the work; token was acquired only at final push and deleted immediately after. All intermediate rounds lived on ephemeral disk only.
incident.mitigation_now_active: option A -- device-flow token held for the duration; push after every verified round

credentials.platform_helper: omnigent.git_credential_github -> ghu_ user-to-server token for the seidroid GitHub App; installed only on sei-protocol (197 repos). Cannot write omnigent-ai/* or bdchatham/*.
credentials.device_flow: gho_ personal OAuth token, scopes gist/read:org/repo, isolated in ~/.config/gh-polly. Writes bdchatham/omnigent. TO BE REVOKED at task end.
credentials.upstream_direct_push: IMPOSSIBLE -- bdchatham has pull-only on omnigent-ai/omnigent (confirmed with a full repo-scoped personal token). Fork -> upstream PR is the only route.
credentials.critical_git_gotcha: an inline `git -c credential.helper=...` is IGNORED: the platform helper is registered in ~/.gitconfig and answers first. Must pass an empty `-c credential.helper=` FIRST to reset the list. See ~/bin/polly-push.sh. Symptom when forgotten: 'Permission to bdchatham/omnigent.git denied to bdchatham' even though the REST API can write refs fine.
credentials.api_permissions_are_not_evidence: gh api repos/<owner>/<repo> .permissions reports the HUMAN's role, not the token's. Use a real ref create/delete probe or a real push.
